$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md at the bank date 2026-11-24 (start the bank with BANK_TODAY=2026-11-24). Every date and every worked figure was computed from the bank's own records. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

Searches: the ledger for 3,275.40 on any account and any date finds nothing. The ledger for the reference UNK-77QX finds nothing. The statement for 3,275.40 finds STM-8501 only.
Rule relied on: RECON-RULE-005. The item is not matched, written off or adjusted. The break is 9 days old, more than 5, so the rule sends it to the Reconciliation Team lead the same day.
